scientific_scope_status: Candidate: reduce fine ore upstream with H2, admit Fe atoms from a continually renewed source into a confined transport path, retain gangue, and reconstruct/harvest solid Fe downstream. The preferred representation is an independently conducting CNT wall with a moving/regrowing solid Fe plug; the permanent 3 nm hot-Fe shell is an optimistic calculator model with unclosed dewetting/continuity premises. Existing prepared pure-Fe nanoscale transport and biased collection are credited antecedents, not a demonstrated raw-ore process or novelty certificate.

depends_on.scope: Source credits Coh et al. PRL110,185901 (2013) prepared solid-Fe transport through CNT constrictions and Melinte et al. NatCommun6,8071 (2015) biased transfer/collection, and imports a clean free-Fe surface diffusion law. These do not establish raw-ore admission, dirty Fe/CNT coefficients, impurity rejection, long lifetime or industrial recovery. Citation and material-law applicability need independent review.

requires_external_validation.scope: Review the stipulated transport/circuit laws and run a frozen <=1 cm^2 isotope-labelled oxide/quartz admission test with all contacts inside a measured V/I/temperature/power boundary. Require feed-derived Fe export beyond 100 times all accessible preloaded inventory, sustained replenishment and repeated harvests, full Fe/carbon/scaffold balance and impurity assay against matched bias-off, reversed, blocked, no-ore and pure-Fe controls. Only then assess untreated real ore, recovery, lifetime and full-process economics.

reported_failed_attempts.attempt: Promote prepared pure-Fe nanotransport to ore export
reported_failed_attempts.failure_scope: Oxide reduction, fresh atom admission, connected accessible Fe fraction, impurity rejection and continuous source/sink interfaces are missing; metallization alone does not imply recovery.

reported_failed_attempts.attempt: Use terminal series wiring to erase local contact and collection cost
reported_failed_attempts.failure_scope: Series reduces terminal current by N and raises voltage by N at unchanged ideal power. Every local contact retains j, conducting product manifolds short the series, and storage-spanning conductor volume/heat and duty cycle remain charged.

reported_failed_attempts.attempt: Claim an energy benefit from avoiding gangue melting
reported_failed_attempts.failure_scope: Optimistic active electricity ~0.297 MWh/t already exceeds the illustrative ~0.260 MWh/t avoided gangue duty before contacts and other process costs. No established net advantage.
